# Reactivity

Signals, memos, effects, owners and scopes: what makes a view update.

## markup.reactive

Source: `lua/markup/reactive.lua`

### markup.reactive.after_flush()

```lua
function markup.reactive.after_flush(job: function)
```

Queues `job` to run once after the next flush's effects.

### markup.reactive.current_owner()

```lua
function markup.reactive.current_owner()
  -> (markup.reactive.owner)?
```

The owner of the code running now.

```lua
function markup.reactive.dispose(target: markup.reactive.owner)
```

### markup.reactive.effect()

```lua
function markup.reactive.effect(fn: function)
  -> markup.reactive.computation
```

Runs `fn` now, and again after anything it read changes.

### markup.reactive.flush()

```lua
function markup.reactive.flush()
```

Runs everything pending now instead of waiting for the scheduled flush.

### markup.reactive.inject()

```lua
function markup.reactive.inject(key: any, fallback: any)
  -> unknown
```

Reads the nearest value set with `provide`.

### markup.reactive.memo()

```lua
function markup.reactive.memo(fn: fun():<T>)
  -> fun():<T>
```

A cached value derived from signals, computed when first read.

### markup.reactive.on_cleanup()

```lua
function markup.reactive.on_cleanup(fn: function)
```

Registers `fn` to run when the current owner is disposed or rerun.

### markup.reactive.provide()

```lua
function markup.reactive.provide(key: any, value: any)
```

Sets a value visible to everything created under the current owner.

### markup.reactive.scope()

```lua
function markup.reactive.scope(fn: fun(owner: markup.reactive.owner):<T>, parent?: markup.reactive.owner)
  -> <T>
  2. markup.reactive.owner
```

Runs `fn` in a new owner that lives until it is disposed.

Pass `parent` when the scope must outlive the computation creating it. An
effect disposes what it owns before each rerun, so `show` and `each` hang
their contents off the owner around their effect.

### markup.reactive.signal()

```lua
function markup.reactive.signal(initial: <T>)
  -> fun(value?: <T>|fun(previous: <T>):<T>):<T>
```

### markup.reactive.stats()

```lua
function markup.reactive.stats()
  -> { effects: integer, memos: integer, scopes: integer, signals: integer, runs: integer, flushes: integer }
```

Live effects, memos and scopes, plus totals since startup. Signals have no
owner, so `signals` counts every one ever created.

### markup.reactive.untrack()

```lua
function markup.reactive.untrack(fn: fun():<T>)
  -> <T>
```

Runs `fn` without subscribing to what it reads.
